## Why

S63 relay later notes and owner decisions of 2026-10-23. (1) After a successful run.cleanup the run record is untouched (internal/daemon/landed.go ~147-156): the row stays merged and keeps offering the cleanup key, and after the next HEAD change its merge state is unknown, so retention never prunes it. Owner: mark the record cleaned and hide it from Ready. (2) If git branch -d fails after git worktree remove succeeded, a retry fails at worktree remove. Owner: skip worktree remove when the worktree is already gone. (3) The merge check clears each run's merged flag at the start of a pass (landed.go ~82), so snapshots show merge state unknown and cleanup is refused while git runs; keep the previous value until the write-back. (4) landed_test.go writes d.runs.merged without the lock (~384) and blockedGit sets GitBin on a live cache (~292): make the tests lock-safe. (5) The help footnote is now under '+2 more lines' in the action-help goldens; help has no scrolling (a help-layout item, noted only).

S31 (2026-10-26, owner screenshot): confirmed live. The owner pressed c on the merged S78 row; the first press removed .worktrees/S78 and branch S78, but the row stayed under Ready to land (run state committed, cleaned unset). The second press showed a raw error: "git -C ... worktree remove ... git -C ... branch -d 'S78': internal: fatal: '.../.worktrees/S78' is not a working tree". Also: the row keeps showing the 'slicer land ... / slicer render' hint after slicer land ran.

- TestMergedValueSurvivesAPass: while a merge check runs, a snapshot still shows the previous merged value; cleanup is not refused for a run whose value is known.
- TestPruneRemovesACleanedFinishedRunBeyondTheKeepLimit.
- Golden views if the Ready list changes.
